title: Lamb Tagine with Spices and Egyptian Kiss
description: A fusion of Chinese and North African flavors, this lamb tagine is a hearty and aromatic dish.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, Chinese five-spice powder, and Egyptian spices.
Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the kissed olives, honey, chicken broth, and crushed tomatoes.
Bring to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 hours, or until tender.
Let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve with the braising liquid spooned over the top.
